decision: For a fragment request in a proven native GNOME terminal, preserve the existing committed-tail writer's layout-postcondition ownership. Use its unchanged background layout completion instead of opting into caller-owned in-place InputMode completion. Bind the new native GNOME fragment caller to the existing scoped output settlement, using its current token and unchanged bridge revalidation before any output; this records each writer epoch in the sole admission reducer.
